note: Every unit rate carries a source basis. These are order-of-magnitude planning figures drawn from published incident cost data and contractor rate ranges, not quotations. Change them to match a site's own numbers; the engine re-derives everything downstream.

productSources.eurPerM3: ex-terminal bulk price per cubic metre at delivery
productSources.recoveryContained: fraction recoverable from intact secondary containment by vacuum truck
productSources.recoveryEscaped: fraction recoverable once product has left the containment to ground or drainage

terminalSources.cleanupPerContainedM3: vacuum collection, waste classification and disposal per m3 of hazardous liquid
terminalSources.remediationPerEscapedM3: soil and groundwater remediation per m3 that reached the environment, including sampling and reporting
terminalSources.investigationFlatEur: internal root cause investigation, management time and legal review for a reportable event
terminalSources.rackIdleEurPerHour: contribution margin lost per hour a loading bay plus one tank are out of service
terminalSources.flushFlatEur: downgrade of commingled product and line flushing after a misrouting
terminalSources.abortedBatchEur: tanker demurrage and re-dispatch when a transfer has to be stopped and re-planned

furnaceSources.deflagrationRepairEur: rebuild of furnace shell, burner blocks and lining after an internal deflagration
furnaceSources.refractoryRepairEur: cut-out and re-gun of a damaged roof or sidewall lining
furnaceSources.hotspotRepairEur: unscheduled outage for a shell hot spot: cool, survey, patch, dry out
furnaceSources.lineIdleEurPerHour: contribution margin lost per hour a reheat furnace is off line ahead of the rolling mill
furnaceSources.repeatHeatupEur: fuel and crew for an aborted cure cycle that has to be restarted from cold

fineSources.reportableThresholdM3: quantity that makes a release reportable to the competent authority
fineSources.fixedEur: median administrative penalty for a first reportable release
fineSources.perEscapedM3Eur: additional penalty scaling with the quantity that reached the environment
fineSources.capEur: upper band observed for a single-site release without injury

escalationSources.ignitionProbabilityPerEvent: probability that a flammable release on an operating rack finds an ignition source during the event
escalationSources.catastrophicEur: loss of the tank farm and adjacent process units, business interruption and third party liability for a vapour cloud ignition
escalationSources.byClass: ignition probability conditioned on the release mechanism; a roof overflow atomising light product is more likely to ignite than a pool held in a bund
